cards.title: Everything that happened, in order
cards.text: 54 on-track passes, 21 pit stops, 4 cars that never finished, 1 safety car.

cards.title: 29 places changed hands on track before the first lap was done
cards.text: 22 cars into the first corner on cold tyres and full tanks.
bullets: Sainz, Albon and Perez gained the most by the end of it, 4 places each
cards.note: Most of this is the pack sorting itself out. Some of it decides the race.

cards.title: 7 passes on this lap alone
cards.text: Only moves made on track count here, at racing speed.
bullets: 6 different drivers gained a place on this lap
cards.note: Early on, with full tanks and the order still settling.

cards.title: Bortoleto starts P21. Where does he finish?
cards.text: 57 laps to make up ground from there.

cards.title: One of these three does not see the chequered flag. Who?
cards.text: Nothing on the timing screens says it is coming.
cards.reveal: Hulkenberg, on lap 8 of 57. The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Antonelli takes the lead from Leclerc
cards.text: A pass for the lead, made on track at racing speed.

cards.title: Gasly is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 5 of 57, in an Alpine.
bullets: P11 at the start of lap 4
Started P9
1 on-track pass before it happened
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Hadjar is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 5 of 57, in a Red Bull.
bullets: P16 at the start of lap 4
Started P22
4 on-track passes before it happened
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Every gap on track, erased
cards.text: The field bunches up behind the safety car, and whatever anybody had built is gone.
bullets: Leclerc was leading when it came out
He stayed out while Verstappen and Bottas stopped under it
Neutralised until lap 11
cards.note: This early, nobody had a lead to lose. What it did do was hand a cheap stop to whoever was ready to take one.

cards.kicker: Your call on the pit wall
cards.title: Safety car with 51 laps left. You are leading. Box or stay out?
cards.text: The pack is bunched up behind you and a stop costs far less than usual, except that everybody behind can copy you and the one who does not gets the lead.
state: Wiped out by the safety car

choices.label: Box for fresh tyres
choices.sub: Grip for the restart, hand over track position

choices.label: Stay out and defend
choices.sub: Keep the lead on older tyres

outcomes.box: New rubber under a safety car is close to free, and it only works if the cars behind stay out. If they all follow you in, you have spent your lead for nothing.
outcomes.stay: You keep the lead and restart on older tyres, with a queue of fresher cars in your mirrors and no gap to hide in.

cards.reveal: Leclerc stayed out. At the flag it was P1 Antonelli, P2 Norris, P3 Piastri.

cards.title: Lawson is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 7 of 57, in a Racing Bulls car.
bullets: P19 at the start of lap 6
Started P11
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Hulkenberg is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 8 of 57, in an Audi.
bullets: P19 at the start of lap 7
Started P10
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Yellow flags out 8 times
cards.text: Race control waves a yellow for anything on or near the track that should not be there.
bullets: A yellow means slow down and do not overtake in that part of the track
Track sector 15 saw 5 calls, more than anywhere else

cards.title: 5 passes on this lap alone
cards.text: Only moves made on track count here, at racing speed.
bullets: 4 different drivers gained a place on this lap
cards.note: Every one of them on track, with no stops around it.

cards.title: Track between 36°C and 42°C during the race
cards.text: Track temperature changes how much grip the tyres find and how fast they wear. No rain was recorded during the race.

cards.title: Verstappen: 11 passes
cards.text: More than anybody else out there, in a Red Bull.
bullets: P2 on the grid, P5 at the flag
cards.note: Only moves made on track count, with the car ahead at racing speed.

cards.title: Who has the fastest lap on the board at the flag?
cards.text: It usually lands late, when the car is light and the track has rubber all over it.
cards.reveal: Norris on lap 35, 1:31.869, in a McLaren.

cards.title: Russell hit 334 km/h
cards.text: The fastest car in a straight line is often not the fastest car over a lap.
bullets: Russell did it in a Mercedes
cards.note: Top speed says as much about wing level, and about sitting in somebody's tow, as it does about the engine.

cards.title: 21 stops, and the busiest lap saw 3 of them
cards.text: Once one car stops, the cars around it have to answer.
bullets: 3 cars in on each of laps 21, 27 and 28
Shortest time in the pit lane: Russell, 22.0s
Longest: Hulkenberg, 33.7s
cards.note: Pit lane time runs from the entry line to the exit line, stop included.

cards.kicker: Your call on the pit wall
cards.title: You are Verstappen, 0.5s behind Hamilton and going nowhere. Now what?
cards.text: Stuck behind another car your tyres overheat and the car will not turn. Stopping first gives you clean track for two or three laps, which is the whole trick behind the undercut.

choices.label: Box now and undercut
choices.sub: Fresh tyres, clean air, two laps to make it pay

choices.label: Stay out and overcut
choices.sub: Let him stop first, then push on an empty track

choices.label: Forget strategy, pass him
choices.sub: Send it and take the risk

outcomes.box: You spend about 23s in the lane and come out in traffic, betting that two fast laps on new tyres are worth more than the place you just gave up.
outcomes.wait: You stay on old rubber while he gets new ones, and you need clean air plus a mistake from him to make it work.
outcomes.attack: Passing a car with the same tyres on the same fuel is the hardest thing in the sport, and running into the back of him ends both races.

cards.reveal: Verstappen did not stop again. He finished P5, Hamilton P6.

cards.title: 1 penalty handed out
cards.text: Given by the stewards during the race.
bullets: Bottas: a drive-through for speeding in the pit lane
cards.note: A drive-through is a trip down the pit lane at the speed limit without stopping.

cards.title: 51 blue flags waved
cards.text: That is how often a lapped car was told to let the leaders through.

cards.title: Norris: 1:31.869
cards.text: The quickest anybody went all race, in a McLaren.
bullets: Set on lap 35 of 57, in the second half, with the car already lighter than at the start
It is worth no points: the bonus point for it was dropped after 2024

cards.title: Antonelli had the quickest median racing lap
cards.text: No lap 1, no laps in or out of the pits, nothing behind the safety car or the VSC, and the slow outliers trimmed. It does not always match the result.

cards.title: Bortoleto: 5 laps within a second of the car ahead
cards.text: The longest unbroken run like it in the race, from lap 43 to lap 47, at racing speed.
bullets: Following closely costs the car downforce and cooks the front tyres, so sitting there is harder than it looks

cards.title: Leclerc went the other way: 5 places lost
cards.text: Qualifying promised one thing and the race delivered another.
bullets: P3 on the grid, P8 at the flag
Qualifying rewards whoever can put one lap together. A race asks for 57 of them

cards.title: Bortoleto: P21 on the grid, P12 at the flag
cards.text: 9 places gained.
bullets: 3 on-track passes along the way
3 cars that started ahead of him retired

cards.title: Verstappen ran one set for 51 laps
cards.text: The longest anybody stayed out on one set.
bullets: On the hards, lap 7 to lap 57
cards.note: Every lap you stretch is a lap you do not lose in the pit lane. And every lap you stretch is a set of tyres getting slower underneath you.

cards.title: 14 incidents looked at
cards.text: Every one of them logged by race control during the race.
bullets: 1 ended in a penalty, 7 in no further action and 6 left for after the race

cards.title: Antonelli wins it
cards.text: P1 Antonelli · P2 Norris · P3 Piastri.
bullets: After 57 laps, Norris crossed the line 3.264s behind

cards.title: How far behind was Norris at the flag?
cards.text: 57 laps, 1 hour 33 minutes of racing, and it comes down to this one number.
cards.reveal: 3.264 seconds after 57 laps. A trip down the pit lane took about 23s today, which is 7 times the margin this race was decided by.
